mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as rising economic activity boosts equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3 consecutive quarters of GDPC1 growth, or GDPC1 growth reverses in the subsequent quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS remaining above 4.0%, or FEDFUNDS decline reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous quarterly rise in GDPC1 (demand) and fall in UNRATE (labor) indicates strengthening economic momentum and labor market health, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the interaction occurring, or the proxies revert before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% during a late-cycle expansion signals accommodative monetary policy, which lowers long-term interest rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 1.5%, or the regime shifts before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decrease in CPIAUCSL (inflation) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as lower inflation expectations reduce risk premiums and support equity prices.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3 consecutive months of CPIAUCSL decline, or CPIAUCSL increases in the subsequent month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly drop in UNRATE below 4.0% signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE remaining below 4.0%, or UNRATE rises above 4.0% before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous quarterly rise in INDPRO (supply) and decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% indicates expansionary monetary policy and robust production, which lower interest rates and enhance corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the interaction occurring, or the proxies revert before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly surge in GDPC1 (demand) exceeding 5% during a post-shock recovery regime signals rapid economic revival, which amplifies equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 5% in post-shock recovery regime
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 exceeding 5% in the regime, or the regime ends before the horizon.
